value.data: An upscale residential project located on Bellandur Outer Ring Road, offering a tranquil retreat and strategic connectivity to major roads.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally appreciate Vajram Esteva for its luxurious and well-equipped living spaces, convenient location near IT hubs and essential services, and a peaceful community atmosphere. However, some concerns exist regarding local bus connectivity, nighttime road safety in certain areas, and the upkeep of public parks.

data: good connectivity and proximity to essential services and IT parks
spacious and well-ventilated apartments with scenic views
limited bus connectivity in certain local areas
some roads can be deserted at night
